420.offence: Cheating and thereby dishonestly inducing delivery of property, or the making, alteration or destruction of a valuable security.
420.bail_regime: Section 497 Cr.P.C. (falls outside prohibitory clause; punishment up to 7 years; grant of bail is rule and refusal exception per Hakeem v. State 2026 SCMR 792 and Tariq Bashir PLD 1995 SC 34)
420.compoundable: Compoundable when permission is given by the court before which the prosecution is pending.
420.punishment: Imprisonment of either description for 7 years, and fine.
420.fine_wording: and fine (liable to fine per bare act)
420.triable_by: Court of Session, or Magistrate of the first class.
420.source_citation: Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), Act No. V of 1898, Schedule II, p. 254; https://pakistancode.gov.pk/pdffiles/administrator7db1e56f0f1d39a6e67573ec6b0944e2.pdf
420.note: Verified directly from official Pakistan Code bare act PDF. Section 420 Column 5 is Ditto under Section 419 (Not bailable substituted by Ord. XXXIII of 1981, s. 3).

406.bail_regime: Section 497 Cr.P.C. (falls outside prohibitory clause; bail is rule and refusal exception per Hakeem v. State 2026 SCMR 792)
406.compoundable: Not compound-able (under Cr.P.C. Schedule II; compoundable with permission under Section 345(2) Cr.P.C.)
406.punishment: Imprisonment of either description for 3 years, or fine, or both (PPC Section 406 bare act text amended to seven years by Ord. XXXIII of 1981, s. 2).
406.triable_by: Magistrate of the first or second class.
406.source_citation: Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), Act No. V of 1898, Schedule II, p. 253; https://pakistancode.gov.pk/pdffiles/administrator7db1e56f0f1d39a6e67573ec6b0944e2.pdf
406.note: Verified directly from official Pakistan Code bare act PDF.

409.offence: Criminal breach of trust by public servant or by banker, merchant or agent, etc.
409.bail_regime: Section 497 Cr.P.C. (falls within prohibitory clause; punishable with life imprisonment or up to 10 years)
409.punishment: Imprisonment for life or imprisonment of either description for 10 years, and fine.
409.triable_by: Court of Session, or Magistrate of the first class.
409.source_citation: Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), Act No. V of 1898, Schedule II, p. 253; https://pakistancode.gov.pk/pdffiles/administrator7db1e56f0f1d39a6e67573ec6b0944e2.pdf
409.note: Verified directly from official Pakistan Code bare act PDF.

489-F.offence: Dishonestly issuing a cheque for repayment of loan etc.
489-F.bail_regime: Section 497 Cr.P.C. (falls outside prohibitory clause; punishment up to 3 years; bail is rule and refusal exception)
489-F.punishment: Imprisonment of either description for 3 year or with fine, or both.

489F.offence: Dishonestly issuing a cheque for repayment of loan etc.

419.bail_regime: Section 497 Cr.P.C. (falls outside prohibitory clause; punishment up to 3 years; bail is rule)

419.punishment: Imprisonment of either description for 3 years, or fine, or both.

468.offence: Forgery for the Purpose of cheating.
468.bail_regime: Section 497 Cr.P.C. (falls outside prohibitory clause; up to 7 years imprisonment)
468.punishment: Imprisonment of either description for 7 years, and fine.
468.triable_by: Court of Session or Magistrate of the first class.

471.offence: Using as genuine a forged document which is known to be forged.
471.police_arrest: Shall not arrest without warrant (Non-cognizable; unless promissory note of Federal Government)
471.punishment: Punishment for forgery of such document.
471.triable_by: Same Court as that by which the forgery is triable.
